jobs.title: Senior React Developer
jobs.description: Responsible for leading front-end development using React.js, collaborating with UI/UX designers, and mentoring junior developers to build scalable and maintainable web applications.

jobs.title: Frontend Developer
jobs.description: Designs and implements user-facing features using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frameworks like React or Angular, ensuring responsive and accessible web interfaces.

jobs.title: Backend Developer
jobs.description: Builds and maintains server-side application logic, APIs, and databases, ensuring secure, scalable, and high-performance backend systems using technologies like Node.js, Python, or Java.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: Leads product development strategy, defines product roadmaps, gathers user requirements, and works with cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact features and solutions.

jobs.title: UI Designer
jobs.description: Creates visually appealing and user-friendly interfaces by designing layouts, typography, and color schemes that align with user needs and brand identity.
